description: This file defines a class 'ScientificOperatorsPanel' that encapsulates UI elements and interactions for the scientific mode of a calculator application, including buttons for trigonometric functions, angle units, and other scientific operations.

classes.name: ScientificOperatorsPanel
classes.description: Represents the UI panel for scientific operators in the calculator app, providing access to various buttons and controls.

classes.name: AngleOperatorState
classes.description: Enumeration for angle measurement units: Degrees, Radians, Gradians.

classes.name: FEButtonState
classes.description: Enumeration for Fixed to Exponential button states: Normal, Exponential.

methods.name: GetAngleOperatorButton
methods.description: Determines which angle unit button (deg, rad, grad) is present in the current page source.

methods.name: SetAngleOperator
methods.description: Sets the angle measurement unit by clicking the appropriate button until the desired state is active.

methods.name: ResetFEButton
methods.description: Resets the Fixed to Exponential button to its default state.

methods.name: ResetTrigDropdownToggles
methods.description: Resets the trigonometric function dropdown toggles to their default states.
